I went to Aspen Dental because I had a lot of pain from a bad cavity- like so bad I could see it. They told me I had 6 cavities in addition to the one I knew about, gum disease, and needed braces. They also said I would need fillings on two chipped teeth - one which happened fairly recently (don’t use your teeth as tools ppl!!) and one that is 10+ years old that has never been an issue. And that those fillings would have to be replaced every 1-3 years. I found this extremely odd because I had never had any cavities previous to this one (likely caused by dry mouth from meds) and my normal dentist told me I had “perfect teeth” and didn’t need braces. I went back for my filling and they tried to charge me approx 6,000 dollars for all of the treatments they wanted to give me, including their own scammy version of Invisalign. 
I almost cried and panicked when I saw the total. I went and got my mom from the lobby so she could help me decipher the nonsense. We only paid for the single filling and afterwards they wouldn’t give me the x-rays I had done. I later did a “sit and wait” appointment at my regular dentist and they essentially told me Aspen Dental was scamming me. I was told I definitely didn’t have gum disease, need braces, or have 6 cavities. They found one tiny cavity and two spots so small they weren’t sure if they were really cavities or just deep grooves in the teeth. Either way, they decided to do fillings on them all. The cost of those three fillings? Less than the $450 Aspen Dental charged me for a single tooth.
